description.sub_ename: SPECIAL TOPIC ON FAMOUS PROSE WRITERS OF THE TANG DYNASTY
description.describe_ch: 唐代古文承繼先秦兩漢魏晉六朝駢散文之精華，創構新體式、新風格，影響越宋元、明清至民國新文學而未已，極具深入研究探討之價值，因有本課程之開設。復有鑒於學子對韓、柳古文較為熟悉，因此，本課程特別選定韓、柳以外，同樣在唐文形成、演變過程中具有重要地位的作家進行講授，包含陳子昂、王維、李白、杜甫、李華、蕭隱士、元結、獨孤及、李翱、皇甫湜、劉禹錫、白居易、杜牧等十三家，庶幾學子可以開拓視野，對唐代古文特質之形成、變化有更全面之掌握。
description.describe_eh: Tang Dynasty classical prose inherited the essence of parallel prose from the pre-Qin, Han, Wei, Jin, and Six Dynasties periods, creating new forms and styles that influenced literature from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing Dynasties to the Republican era. It is therefore of great value for in-depth research and exploration, hence the offering of this course. Furthermore, given students' familiarity with the classical prose of Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan, this course specifically selects other writers who also played important roles in the formation and evolution of Tang Dynasty prose, including Chen Zi'ang, Wang Wei, Li Bai, Du Fu, Li Hua, Xiao Yinshi, Yuan Jie, Dugu Ji, Li Ao, Huangfu Shi, Liu Yuxi, Bai Juyi, and Du Mu—thirteen in total. This aims to broaden students' horizons and provide a more comprehensive understanding of the formation and changes in the characteristics of Tang Dynasty classical prose.
